list.text: Absolutely lovely, so peak. The man serving us was the nicest person on human earth and so warm and friendly! Such great portions of chicken, actually flavourful food, yummy vegetables, good prices too! I would solely come back for the service, he was genuinely so nice and made our night!! 🌯

The food is awesome! John and Emily are amazing humans :). If you are visiting Ottawa you must try this place. It's very authentic, family owned, it has that spark Ottawa shawarmas are known for. Truly impressed! Great job guys!

Very delicious shawarma! But I especially want to compliment the people who work here — they're incredibly friendly, kind, and welcoming. You can really tell that they care about what they do. I'll definitely be coming back!
That's an amazing place to get shawarmas in a very good price. I am so glad that I stopped by here during my visit. The staff are absolute delight to deal with. A must try, you won't be disappointed.
Lovely guy behind the counter and great chicken poutine! Full of good quality chicken.

We got the falafel wrap and it was amazing. My little sister who hates tomatoes and onions ate the wrap enthusiastically because they were incorporated so well. The woman working was super friendly as well.

story.title: From Beirut to ByWard
story.p1: At Shawarma Time and Place, food is more than a meal — it's a tradition. Inspired by Lebanon's rich culinary heritage, our restaurant was created to bring authentic Lebanese shawarma to the heart of Ottawa's ByWard Market. Every recipe we serve reflects our commitment to quality, authenticity, and fresh ingredients.
story.p2: Shawarma Time and Place is about community, culture, and bringing people together over great food. Whether it's your first visit or your hundredth, we're honored to serve you.
story.p3: Behind every dish is Chef Abou Adal, whose passion for Lebanese cuisine drives everything that comes out of our kitchen. From slow-grilled shawarma meats to freshly prepared falafel, every item is crafted with time-honored techniques, attention to detail, and authentic flavor.
